channel.title: Brio
channel.description: Updates for Brio, the macOS menu-bar developer toolbox.

item.title: 0.9.0-beta.9
item.description:
What changed since v0.9.0-beta.8

  • Size the Settings window to the taller Keep Awake tab
  • Attach each subtitle to its control instead of giving it a row
  • Document the Keep Awake settings grouping
  • Group the Keep Awake settings into three sections
  • Read the display settings positively without migrating them
  • Plan the Keep Awake settings UX pass
  • Design the Keep Awake settings UX pass

item.title: 0.9.0-beta.8
item.description:
What changed since v0.9.0-beta.7

  • Let the display stay lit when the screen locks
  • Document release pruning and correct the re-run runbook
  • Correct the re-run runbook for --keep 2 and bound the poll's fetch
  • Make the appcast poll loop fail closed on a failed fetch
  • Apply the release-prune fix wave from whole-branch review
  • Prune superseded releases when a new one ships
  • Prune superseded appcast items per channel
  • Add plan for pruning superseded releases
  • Add design for pruning superseded releases
